nodes.label: Stock market and ordering
nodes.text: Owns the stock-market grid state: token piles, price lookup, yellow-zone test, token moves (down on sale, up on sell-out), start-token placement, descending-share-price order, operating order, game-end-cell test.

nodes.label: Holdings, certificate counting and directorship
nodes.text: Owns who holds which units/certificates of each major company and of concessions/privates/minors; certificate counting, certificate limit, 60% cap, sell legality incl. director succession, forced-sell test, sold-out test, director swap.

nodes.label: Player turn actions on shares
nodes.text: Implements the player actions sell shares, buy share, convert concession, repay loans with all preconditions/effects; owns loans, sold-this-round set, company treasuries and major company status.

nodes.label: Bidding
nodes.text: Owns bids on box items: legality of placing/moving bids, highest bid/bidder, committed money, tokens in use, face values and minimum bids.

nodes.label: Bid boxes and item stacks
nodes.text: Owns the three item stacks and the 4/3/3 bid boxes: compaction, refill, vacating items to players/removal, concession clearing at phase 5, minor ownership state.

nodes.label: Phase, train deck, train purchase
nodes.text: Owns game phase, the bank train deck and bank pool, company train lists: buying trains from the bank in order, side choice L/2 and 7/E, train limit, one-E-train limit, L->2 upgrade, phase advance, rusting, discard of excess trains, train exports, concession clearing trigger.

nodes.label: Round engine, setup, game end, ledger
nodes.text: Owns game setup (given new_game), the stock-round AND operating-round state machines (turn record, pass streak, round type, operating-round set bookkeeping, operating order), player order state, cash and bank ledger, the 'a sale happened' flag, game-end triggers and their maturity, start-of-operating-round revenues (private companies, concessions), wealth and final ranking.

nodes.label: End-of-stock-round resolution
nodes.text: Implements the end-of-round procedure: award/pay bid winners, float minors, unsold-minor train exports, box-1 removal, interest, price rises for sold-out companies, cash-based reorder of players; owns resolution-scratch state.

nodes.label: player
nodes.text: A player: holds cash, loans, certificates, concessions, privates, minors, bidding tokens; has a stock-turn order position.

nodes.label: private company
nodes.text: Private company certificate (face value 0). Obtained only through a bid box (3.1.4); never sold or traded (3.1.6).

nodes.label: concession
nodes.text: Concession certificate of one major company (face value 100, 3.4.2). Counts against certificate limit; converts to a director's certificate in phases 2-4.

nodes.label: minor company
nodes.text: Minor company (M1..M24). One 50% director's certificate worth two shares; no other shares (3.2.2). Obtained only through a bid box; never sold (3.2.5).

nodes.label: major company
nodes.text: Major company with 9 certificates (one 20% director's certificate + eight 10% shares); LNWR has 10 certificates of 10% (3.3.2).

nodes.label: lnwr
nodes.text: London & North Western Railway: special major company, 10 certificates of 10%; director's certificate is a single 10% unit; concession on top of stack (1.7.4).

nodes.label: director certificate
nodes.text: Director's certificate: counts as 2 units (LNWR 1 unit) of ownership but as exactly ONE certificate for the certificate limit.

nodes.label: share certificate
nodes.text: Ordinary 10% share certificate: 1 unit, 1 certificate.

nodes.label: bid box
nodes.text: Bidding box for one item kind (4 minor boxes, 3 concession boxes, 3 private boxes), numbered from 1; holds at most one item and the bidding tokens on it.

nodes.label: bidding token
nodes.text: A player's bidding token; sits on a space of an item's bid track whose value is the bid; cannot be withdrawn (4.10.10).

nodes.label: stock market
nodes.text: The stock market grid; rows left-aligned as printed (R12).

nodes.label: market cell
nodes.text: One cell of the grid: has a value (price), optional yellow flag, optional game-end flag, optional start-value marking; holds an ordered pile of tokens.

nodes.label: stock token
nodes.text: A company's share-price token on the market.

nodes.label: train
nodes.text: A train in the bank deck (types L/2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7/E).

nodes.label: bank
nodes.text: The bank: cash 12000 total supply incl. player start money; may go negative (broken).

nodes.label: bank pool
nodes.text: Pool where sold shares go; max 50% of a company's stock (5 units).

nodes.label: company treasury
nodes.text: A company's cash and unsold shares (treasury shares).

nodes.label: loan
nodes.text: Debt of a player to the bank (outside the bank's 12000, 4.3.5).

nodes.label: item stack
nodes.text: Face-up stack of concessions / minors / privates, top item goes to the lowest empty box.

nodes.label: player order card
nodes.text: Player-number card; defines the stock-turn order.

nodes.label: game
nodes.text: Whole-game container: phase, round counter, flags, end trigger.

nodes.label: Start money per player
nodes.text: Starting money = 2100 / player count: 3p 700, 4p 525, 5p 420, 6p 350, 7p 300 (1.7.2). Player counts 3..7 inferred from this list.

nodes.label: Bank total
nodes.text: Bank is 12000 including players' starting money; initial bank cash = 12000 - n*start_money = 9900 (1.7.2). Loans are outside this sum (4.3.5).

nodes.label: Start values
nodes.text: Allowed starting share prices: 50 (solid red, minors only, 1.6.3), 60, 70, 80, 90, 100 (red-outlined, majors and minors, 1.6.4). Major start price must be in {60..100}.

nodes.label: Face values
nodes.text: Face value: concession 100 (3.4.2), minor 100 (R1), private 0 (3.1.3). Opening bid >= face value (4.10.6).

nodes.label: Bid box counts
nodes.text: 4 minor boxes, 3 concession boxes, 3 private boxes (4.10.1). Box numbers start at 1.

nodes.label: Bid rule numbers
nodes.text: Bids are whole multiples of 5 (4.10.6); at most 3 bids placed/moved per stock turn (4.10.5); no upper bound on a bid (4.10.9).

nodes.label: Share structure of a major company
nodes.text: Total 10 units. Standard major: director's certificate = 2 units, 8 ordinary certificates of 1 unit. LNWR: director's certificate = 1 unit, 9 ordinary certificates. Minor: one director's certificate worth 2 shares, no other shares (3.2.2). Pool cap 5 units (4.4.2); player cap 6 units (4.5.6).

nodes.label: Rust table
nodes.text: Phase 3 rusts L; phase 4 rusts 2; phase 6 rusts 3; phase 7 rusts 4 (2.2.4-2.2.8).

nodes.label: Loan interest
nodes.text: End of stock round: loans += ceil(loans/2) (4.3.4, 4.11.10, R14).

nodes.label: Stack setup
nodes.text: Concession stack: 9 shuffled + LNWR on top (1.7.4). Minor stack: 23 shuffled + M24 on top (1.7.5). Private stack: 17 shuffled + P1 on top (1.7.6). 1822+ extras out of scope.

nodes.label: Player count
nodes.text: Number of players n; set once at setup.

nodes.label: Player cash
nodes.text: Cash in hand of each player. Never negative.

nodes.label: Player loans
nodes.text: Outstanding loans of each player. Created by operating-round forced train purchase / emergency money raising (out of scope); reduced by repay_loans; increased by interest.

attrs.external_note: Increases from forced train purchases are provided by the operating-round module (5.14/5.15, out of scope); this graph writes only repay and interest.

nodes.label: Bank cash
nodes.text: Cash of the bank. Starts 9900. 'Broken' when < 0 (assumption A29). Loans are NOT part of it (4.3.5).

nodes.label: Game phase
nodes.text: Current phase; starts at 1 (2.2.2); advances when the first train of a type is bought or exported (2.1.1).

nodes.label: Consecutive passes
nodes.text: Number of consecutive turns that were passes; round ends when it equals the player count (4.11.1).

nodes.label: Ordinary certificates held
nodes.text: Number of ordinary 10% certificates a player holds in a major company. EXCLUDES the director's certificate, which is stored in director_holder. units_held = ordinary_certs + director units; certs_held = ordinary_certs + (1 if director).

nodes.label: Director's certificate holder
nodes.text: Holder of the director's certificate of a major company (null until the company is started). The director's certificate = cert_units units (2; LNWR 1) but ONE certificate for limit counting.

nodes.label: Treasury shares
nodes.text: Ordinary certificates in the company treasury, buyable at the current price (4.5.1, 4.7.3). 8 (LNWR 9) at flotation.

nodes.label: Bank-pool shares
nodes.text: Ordinary certificates in the bank pool. Max 5 (50%) (4.4.2).

nodes.label: Major company status
nodes.text: Floated once its concession is converted (4.7.3). Phase-5 direct formation deferred (R11).

nodes.label: Market piles
nodes.text: Which company tokens sit on which cell and their pile order. Company price = value of its cell. Pile order decides ties (1.6.2, 4.4.5, 4.12.2, 5.2.2).

nodes.label: Concessions held
nodes.text: Concession certificates a player holds (acquired after resolution, 4.7.5). Removed at phase 5 (R9).

nodes.label: Privates held
nodes.text: Private companies held by each player.

nodes.label: Minor director's certificate holder
nodes.text: Player holding the 50% director's certificate of a minor (counts 1 certificate; assumption A6). Non-null = purchased and floated.

nodes.label: Concession stack
nodes.text: Remaining concessions; top goes to lowest empty concession box. LNWR on top at setup (1.7.4). Emptied at phase 5 (R9).

nodes.label: Minor stack
nodes.text: Remaining minors; M24 on top at setup (1.7.5).

nodes.label: Private stack
nodes.text: Remaining privates; P1 on top at setup (1.7.6).

nodes.label: Bid-box contents
nodes.text: Item sitting in each box: minor boxes 1..4, concession boxes 1..3, private boxes 1..3.

nodes.label: Items removed from play
nodes.text: Items removed from the game (unsold box-1 minor, concessions at phase 5). Audit only; consumed by operating rounds for minor-acquisition rules.

attrs.external_note: Consumer is the operating-round module (acquisition rules, out of scope).

nodes.label: Bids on box items
nodes.text: Bidding tokens on each item's track: at most one token per player per item (assumption A5). Amount = bid. Highest bid = max amount. Cleared at resolution (4.11.2).

nodes.label: Swap director's certificate
nodes.text: Exchange the director's certificate for ordinary certificates of the new director (3.3.3).

preconditions.check: q != director_holder[c] and ordinary_certs[q,c] >= cert_units(c)

effects: [3.3.3] old = director_holder[c]
[4.4.2, 4.5.9] ordinary_certs[q,c] -= cert_units(c); ordinary_certs[old,c] += cert_units(c); director_holder[c] = q
total units of every holder unchanged; certificate counts change: q -(cert_units-1), old +(cert_units-1) (LNWR: no change)

nodes.label: Director certificate units
nodes.text: Units of 10% that a director's certificate counts as.

attrs.formula: [3.3.2] 1 if c = LNWR else 2. As certificates the director's certificate always counts exactly 1.

nodes.label: Units held
nodes.text: Units of 10% a player holds in a major company.

attrs.formula: [4.5.6] ordinary_certs[p,c] + (cert_units(c) if director_holder[c] == p else 0)

nodes.label: Certificates held
nodes.text: Number of certificate cards a player holds in a company, for limit counting.

attrs.formula: [4.2.2] major: ordinary_certs[p,c] + (1 if director_holder[c]==p else 0); minor: 1 if minor_director[c]==p else 0

nodes.label: Certificates held counted against the limit
nodes.text: Certificates a player owns that count toward the limit.

attrs.formula: [4.2.2, 3.1.5, 3.4.3, 4.2.3] sum over majors and minors c of (0 if in_yellow(c) else certs_held(p,c)) + |player_privates[p]| + |player_concessions[p]| (P16 not exempted, R11)

nodes.label: Certificate count incl. leading bids
nodes.text: Count used for every 'at the limit' test.

attrs.formula: [4.2.5, 4.10.8] cert_count_holdings(p) + items_led(p)

nodes.label: Over the limit?
nodes.text: True when a player holds more than the limit.

attrs.formula: [4.2.6, 4.4.7] cert_count(p) > cert_limit

nodes.label: Eligible successor director
nodes.text: Player who would become director if the director's remaining holding is r.

attrs.formula: [4.4.2, R5] candidates = {q != d : units_held(q,c) >= cert_units(c) and units_held(q,c) > r}; none -> null; else max units_held; tie -> the tying player closest after d in sr_order (cyclic, forward)

nodes.label: Able to sell anything?
nodes.text: True if at least one sale of one share is legal.

attrs.formula: [4.4.7] exists major c: sale_legal(p,c,1).legal

nodes.label: Forced to sell?
nodes.text: True when over the limit and able to sell.

attrs.formula: [4.4.7, R10] over_limit(p) and can_sell_any(p)

nodes.label: Company 100% in players' hands?
nodes.text: Sold-out test for the price rise.

attrs.formula: [4.12.1, R13, 4.12.3] major_status[c]==floated and treasury_shares[c]==0 and pool_shares[c]==0 (minors: always false)

nodes.label: Move token down
nodes.text: Price drop after a sale: move down one row per share sold.

preconditions.check: c has a token on the market

effects: [4.4.4, R12] row' = row; repeat s times: if cell (row'+1, col) exists then row' += 1 else stop
[4.4.5] if the cell changed: remove c from its pile and append at the BOTTOM of the destination pile; if not, keep its place in the pile

nodes.label: Move token up
nodes.text: Price rise for a sold-out company: one row up, same column.

preconditions.check: c has a token on the market

effects: [4.12.1, R12] if cell (row-1, col) exists: move there, else no move
[4.12.2] appended at the BOTTOM of the destination pile
[10.1.1] if the new cell is a game-end cell: call check_game_end_triggers(after_token_move)

nodes.label: Token cell
nodes.text: Cell where a company's token sits.

attrs.formula: [1.6.1] the cell whose pile in market_stack contains c

nodes.label: Current price
nodes.text: Share price of a company.

attrs.formula: [1.6.1] grid_value(token_cell(c))

nodes.label: In yellow zone?
nodes.text: True if the company's token is on a yellow cell.

attrs.formula: [1.6.5, 4.2.3] token_cell(c) in yellow_cells; false if the company has no token

nodes.label: Descending share price order
nodes.text: Sort companies by share price order.

attrs.formula: [1.6.2] sort by key (-price, -col, pile_index_from_top); price desc; same price -> larger column first; same cell -> topmost first; (assumption A26: same price and same column in different rows -> upper row first)

nodes.label: Next company to operate
nodes.text: Choose the next company after the previous one finished.

params: set of companies already run this OR

attrs.formula: [5.2.2] recompute operating_order now (stock sales during OR may reorder) and take the first company not in done; minors before majors

nodes.label: Game-end cell?
nodes.text: True if the company's token is on a game-end cell.

attrs.formula: [10.1.1] token_cell(c) in game_end_cells

nodes.label: Face value of an item
nodes.text: Minimum opening bid for the item kind.

attrs.formula: [3.4.2, 3.1.3, R1] concession 100; minor 100; private 0

nodes.label: Highest bid
nodes.text: Highest bid placed on an item.

attrs.formula: [4.10.7] max over bids[item].values(), or none

nodes.label: Highest bidder
nodes.text: Player with the highest bid on an item.

attrs.formula: [4.10.7] argmax of bids[item]; unique because every new bid must be higher

nodes.label: Committed money
nodes.text: Money a player is committed to pay for items they lead.

attrs.formula: [4.10.7] sum of highest_bid(item) over items with highest_bidder(item)==p; outbid items do not count

nodes.label: Items led
nodes.text: Number of items on which the player has the highest bid.

attrs.formula: [4.2.5] count of items with highest_bidder(item)==p

nodes.label: Tokens in use
nodes.text: Tokens a player currently has on items, led or outbid.

attrs.formula: [4.10.10] count of items with p in bids[item] (tokens stay until resolution)

nodes.label: Minimum legal bid
nodes.text: Smallest bid currently legal on an item.

attrs.formula: [4.10.6, 4.10.7, R1] face_value(item) if no bids else highest_bid(item)+5

nodes.label: Is the bid amount valid?
nodes.text: All amount-related checks shared by place_bid and move_bid.

attrs.formula: [4.10.6, 4.10.7, 4.10.9] amount % 5 == 0 and amount >= min_legal_bid(item) and committed_money(p) + amount <= player_cash[p] (p does not currently lead the item, so it is not double counted); no upper bound

nodes.label: Compact boxes
nodes.text: Shift items to the lowest-numbered boxes of their kind, preserving order.

preconditions.check: applies to every kind separately

effects: [4.10.2, 4.11.8] for each kind: items in boxes 1..m moved to the lowest-numbered boxes in the same relative order
errors: NONE for legal input: total function when called in the documented order; ERR_ORDER if invoked out of sequence (e.g. outside resolve_stock_round)

nodes.label: Refill boxes
nodes.text: Shift then fill empty boxes from the stacks, lowest box first.

preconditions.check: concession kind skipped when phase >= 5

effects: [4.10.2] call shift_boxes
